content:
**base-branch is a tracker head by declaration, and a parent resolves from prose with no block**

Cold review remediation of the #967 tracker PR (round 2): baseBranchRule and its run-check.mjs wrapper classified any feature/-prefixed head as a tracker's own PR with zero reads instead of checking the linked issue's own declared tracker, wrongly rejecting an ordinary slice branch already correctly based on its epic's tracker (measured: feature/issue-42-my-feature). Fixed by reading the one fact the rule holds: headBranch must equal the linked issue's own kind:epic + tracker: declaration. Separately, parseGraphBlock returned null before its prose scan ever ran when a body carried no brain-graph/1 block at all, hiding a line-initial Parent: #N declaration from buildGraph, ticket-base.mjs's parentOf, and the gate. Extracted parentFromProse and a new declaredParent(body) so the prose fallback applies block-or-no-block as R967-2 already required; a malformed block still never falls back to prose. spec.md R967-2 and R967-7 amended. Full suite 5674/0 (baseline 5663), counted diff 180.
